title: AML Transaction Monitoring & Alert Triage System
summary: A production-grade anti-money-laundering pipeline that turns 19M transactions into a short, explainable queue of alerts for analysts.
highlights: Combined SQL typology rules (CTEs, window functions, recursive queries), Isolation Forest anomaly scoring and NetworkX graph analysis, cutting a raw 84% flag rate to a 0.9% actionable alert rate
Designed a GDPR-compliant PostgreSQL schema with HMAC-SHA256 pseudonymisation, EXPLAIN ANALYZE-tuned indexed queries and a data retention policy aligned with UK GDPR, MLR 2017 and POCA 2002

Delivered a FastAPI REST API (6 endpoints) and a 4-page Plotly Dash dashboard surfacing risk scores and LLM-generated SAR narratives, deployed to Azure Container Apps with Docker Compose and a GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline

title: AgroIE — Bilingual RAG Assistant for Irish Farmers
mediaAlt: AgroIE architecture: chat (RAG), language, ingestion and weather microservices
summary: A retrieval-augmented chatbot that answers farming questions in English and Irish (Gaeilge), grounded in Teagasc guidelines, CAP/BISS schemes, Irish nitrates rules and live Met Éireann weather.
highlights: Built a RAG pipeline that detects the question's language, translates Irish queries for vector search, retrieves cited chunks and translates the answer back, so every reply links to its source documents
Split the system into FastAPI microservices (gateway, chat, language, ingestion, weather), each containerised with Docker and runnable together with Docker Compose
Designed one codebase for two environments: Ollama, ChromaDB and sentence-transformers locally for free, and AWS Bedrock (Claude 3 Sonnet, Titan embeddings) with Amazon OpenSearch in production
Provisioned AWS infrastructure (VPC, EKS, OpenSearch, ECR, S3, IAM) with Terraform, and a GitHub Actions pipeline that builds every service image, pushes to ECR and deploys to EKS

details.heading: How a question flows
points: The gateway checks the user's AWS Cognito JWT and routes the request (auth is mocked in local development)
The language service detects English or Irish with langdetect, an Irish keyword check and AWS Comprehend as a fallback, then translates with AWS Translate using a custom farming glossary
The chat service embeds the question, retrieves the closest chunks and prompts the LLM to answer only from that context, citing sources and saying so when the context is not enough

details.heading: Knowledge base
points: Teagasc guidance on grass, soil fertility, dairy, beef and tillage
Department of Agriculture CAP/BISS scheme information, Bord Bia standards and Met Éireann live weather for each county

details.heading: Still to build
points: Next.js bilingual chat UI, subsidy and user-profile services, and Prometheus/Grafana observability
